cells.rationale: The 10-year sat almost exactly on the line: 4.96% on 2026-10-22 (govspending.org, H.15), 5.00% on 2026-10-23 (Treasury par curve via spotthemoney.com) and about 4.99% on 2026-10-26 (Trading Economics), so the question is nearly a coin flip over the 3-4 trading days left, with a typical move of 10-15 bp. An exact 5.00% print resolves No, which shaves a little off 50%, and the yield has drifted down about 25 bp from early-October highs; my earlier 'above X' yield calls at 55-56% were all wrong, so I stay slightly under even. FOMC, GDP and refunding news this week are unverified but add variance without a clear direction.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
